name: UK/IE D365 Lead Conservation Behavior
description: Behavior cases for retaining plausible non-hard leads, resolving end customers, avoiding invented facts, and reporting shortages.

parts.text: A partner case-study page mentions a UK customer using Dynamics 365. Explain how the pipeline should keep the lead while separating the partner source from the end-customer account.
If a promising D365 candidate only has a Google grounding redirect URL at first, should it be rejected or retained? Describe the required cleanup artifact.
A company appears in a previous pack but now has a separate public Business Central upgrade signal. Explain the duplicate policy without banning the company outright.
If the run finds only 8 final-ready non-duplicate leads, what should the agent produce instead of inventing 4 more?
